text: ed, we find a real fulphur flicking in the neck of the ma-tras and, while the phofhorus is burning, it hasn plainly a frong fulphuceus finally. It is therefore cer-tain, that this phofhorus contains an adult fulphur; that is, a means ofgifted to take five with the spreift safe. But though fulphur be very inflammable, it never takes fire of itself, without being either in contact with forms matter to actuality ignored, we still being expelled to a considerable degree of heat. Let us be then what may be the cause of its ascention, when it is a confitment part of the phofhorus.
